topic: anterior commissure anatomy, evolution, and consciousness integration in split-brain

sources.title: Rapid homotopic communication between human orbitofrontal subregions
sources.authors: Starkweather CK, Willbrand EH, Sellers KK, et al.
sources.role_in_article: direct evidence for anterior commissure participation in OFC interhemispheric communication
sources.key_data: Bilateral iEEG CCEP mapping; homotopic medial-to-medial and lateral-to-lateral OFC connectivity; rapid short-latency responses across hemispheres via CC and AC

sources.title: Microsurgical anatomy of the anterior commissure with special emphasis on the anterior limb: a comparative white matter fiber microdissection and tractography study
sources.role_in_article: comparative anatomy: anterior limb larger in sheep than humans, evolutionary argument
sources.key_data: 20 human cadaver brains + 3 sheep brains; Klingler fiber dissection + MR tractography; anterior limb more prominent in sheep

sources.title: The Bulb, the Brain and the Being: New Insights into Olfactory System Anatomy, Organization and Connectivity
sources.role_in_article: olfactory connectivity of AC; FA and RD metrics
sources.key_data: AC closely related to olfactory striae; DTI: FA=0.3420, RD=0.2238

sources.title: Microsurgical anatomy of the anterior commissure: correlations with diffusion tensor imaging fiber tracking and clinical relevance
sources.role_in_article: detailed fiber dissection anatomy; anterior limb sometimes absent; dense 3D network with uncinate fasciculus
sources.key_data: 8 formalin-fixed human brains; Klingler + DTI; anterior olfactory limb sometimes absent in dissection

sources.title: White-matter commissures: a clinically focused anatomical review
sources.role_in_article: review of AC as olfactory commissure; clinical implications in AgCC and AD

sources.title: The role of the anterior commissure in callosal agenesis
sources.role_in_article: key compensatory evidence: enlarged AC enables near-normal interhemispheric visual matching in AgCC
sources.key_data: J.P. (enlarged AC): near-normal performance; M.M. (normal AC): significant deficit; n=2+10 controls

sources.title: [Interhemispheric transfer and agenesis of the corpus callosum. Capacities and limitations of the anterior commissure]
sources.role_in_article: limits of AC compensation: even enlarged AC cannot normalize all interhemispheric transfer tests

sources.title: Brain functional connectivity in individuals with callosotomy and agenesis of the corpus callosum: A systematic review
sources.authors: Mancuso L, Cauda F, et al.
sources.role_in_article: systematic review showing surprisingly intact FC in congenital AgCC; subcortical pathways maintain bilateral coupling

sources.title: The Split-Brain Phenomenon Revisited: A Single Conscious Agent with Split Perception
sources.authors: Pinto Y, de Haan EHF, Lamme VAF
sources.role_in_article: key claim: split-brain produces one agent with split perception; challenges classical two-agent view
sources.key_data: n=2; any hand/voice can report both visual fields above chance
sources.evidence_strength: medium (small n; cross-cueing not fully excluded)

sources.title: Split-Brain: What We Know Now and Why This Is Important for Understanding Consciousness
sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Corballis PM, Hillyard SA, et al.
sources.role_in_article: comprehensive review; evidence insufficient for definitive answer; subcortical pathways including AC noted

sources.title: Unified Tactile Detection and Localisation in Split-Brain Patients
sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Fabri M, Ntbalikure M, et al.
sources.role_in_article: tactile evidence for preserved cross-hemisphere coarse detection; failure of fine bilateral comparison

sources.title: Visual integration across fixation: automatic processes are split but conscious processes remain unified in the split-brain
sources.role_in_article: two-route model: automatic processing split; deliberate conscious processing unified

sources.title: Corpus callosum structure and auditory interhemispheric transfer in spina bifida myelomeningocele
sources.role_in_article: direct quantitative evidence: AC cross-sectional area predicts auditory interhemispheric transfer when CC is hypoplastic
sources.key_data: n=46 SBM + 15 controls; AC CSA predicts right-ear advantage; CC splenium/posterior hypoplasia impairs dichotic listening

sources.title: The connectional anatomy of the temporal lobe
sources.role_in_article: AC role in interhemispheric temporal lobe connectivity; human vs primate differences

summary.note: No direct NIH/NINDS/official institution source found specifically for anterior commissure; institutional knowledge covered via PubMed-indexed reviews.
